Thanks again for turning around early questions on our procurement checklist. Attached is the latest Meditiq PIA template (Meditiq_PIA_Template_v3.xlsx) — it’s the customer-facing DPIA spreadsheet we run with our NHS customers. We’re on a tight schedule with two trusts that want the completed template and supporting evidence by COB Nov 1 so legal can sign off for a pilot.

High-level asks from the spreadsheet:
- Data flow summary for each product feature (what is sent to Redwood, where it’s processed, what is persisted).

- Retention windows and a sample retention policy excerpt.
- Transfers / SCCs / special-category processing notes.
- Any technical mitigations (encryption in transit/at rest, KV/prefix caching behavior) and people/process controls.

We expect a mixture of short answers in the template and 2–3 supporting artifacts (data flow diagram, evidence index, sample DPA clause). Can you confirm whether you can:
1) Fill the template with brief answers and source references, and
2) Share an evidence index PDF that maps template rows to Redwood artifacts (policy, SOC2 section, log sample, config screenshots).

If possible we’d like a 30-minute walkthrough on Oct 28 to run the template together and resolve open items. Please advise availability.

Attachments: Meditiq_PIA_Template_v3.xlsx (Excel template, 36 rows)

Olivia, Grace — quick technical clarifications so we can populate the template correctly:

- Data persistence: Redwood does not persist raw customer inputs by default. We persist model context (KV cache) in volatile memory during inference and only persist artifacts when explicitly configured (e.g., customer opt-in logs or long-term embeddings). We can provide config screenshots showing default settings.
- Special categories: we treat special-category data according to customer-provided lawful basis. For customers under NHS trust contracts we recommend contractual safeguards and data minimization.
- Transfers & SCCs: Redwood supports SCCs for controller-processor relationships; our DPA and standard SCC text can be attached as a sample clause.
- DPIA mapping: I’ll prepare a short data flow diagram (SVG/PDF) and call out where encryption, KV cache TTL, and prefix caching apply per feature.

Deliverables I’ll provide by Oct 29: data flow diagram, a short technical note on caching/TTL, and pointer to the SOC 2 control sections that map to the template rows.

-Karthik
